session.instructions: Is the player responding to joystick input on a playable game screen? Read measured_control_response: a positive displacement of at least 5 pixels in either direction, with input_effect_verified and native_playable_screen_verified true, supports active control. A blocked edge in the other direction is not a failed start. No input-dependent motion or an unplayable screen means not_started. Missing facts means unknown. Judge startup only.

criteria.active: Verified input-dependent movement with a playable native screen
criteria.not_started: Attract/demo, terminal or no player-control evidence
